**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching obligation on The Deerskin Companies (or on HDI). This matches our preferred playbook position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no edit is warranted. If HDI later proposes adding one, our fallback is a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no "no-hire."

Two adjacent points worth noting for the broader review (outside this rule): Section 6.1 imposes a term-length market exclusivity on the Company, and Section 6.3 imposes a two-year post-term restriction on HDI — those are product/market non-competes and should be assessed under the non-compete rule rather than here.
